blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A 66-year-old man was found dead under a bridge in Barangay Casiligan, Pola town, on Saturday, Oct. 3, police said. The body was discovered after a barangay official alerted the Pola Municipal Police Station. Police responded and conducted an initial investigation. Residents told police that the man was last seen possibly under the influence of alcohol.
